Services

In the salon

From the salon’s Instagram and what clients write on Google.

Hair colouring and cuts

Colouring is the salon’s focus on Instagram. Clients write about hair colour, blowouts, short cuts and pixie cuts.

Manicure and pedicure

Gel polish, French manicure and pedicure, with attention to shape and detail.

Brows and lashes

Brow shaping, styling and colouring, and lashes, according to several reviews.

Makeup

Makeup, and one client writes about coming back for it for the third time.

In the salon

Photos from the salon’s Google listing.

A visit

Taken from what clients write in their Google reviews.

A beautiful space

Many reviews call the salon beautiful and cozy, and one client first noticed the building’s design while passing by.

Coffee while you wait

10 reviews mention coffee during the visit, and the salon writes on Instagram that it treats its guests.

Easy to book

Online booking through the salon’s booking page, walk-ins accepted, and a free parking lot, according to Google.

In Agios Athanasios

SOK Beauty Salon is in the Vrahimis Building on Ayios Athanasios 59. The photos show a light space with arched shelves, round lamps, soft white chairs and a wooden reception counter with the illuminated SOK sign. On Instagram the salon calls itself your beauty friend in Limassol.
